content.intro: In this lesson, you will learn **Extension Functions** as part of **Functions and Parameters**. Kotlin functions can expose parameters and return types, and function values/lambdas allow behavior to be passed to or returned from other functions. Use the subtopics—Declaring Extension Functions, Extension Resolution, Extension Functions and API Design—as a checklist: predict what the example will do, then verify it in a project configured for the target platform.
content.why_it_matters: Functions, null safety, strings, and collections are the building blocks of most practical Kotlin code. Choosing the right operation reduces avoidable errors and makes behavior easier to test.
